## Linear sequence

Inputs: `cycle_start`, `end1`, `end2`. Outputs: `output1`, `output2`.

### Work to do

1. On `cycle_start`, activate `output1`.
2. On `end1`, deactivate `output1` and activate `output2`.
3. On `end2`, deactivate `output2`.
4. On a new press of `cycle_start`, resume the cycle from the beginning.
